lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is narrower in the anterior section and becomes progressively wider across the central torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first three anterior lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral fringe; the tenth posterior line is segmented and does not reach the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Four high-contrast white spots observed on the upper hindquarters/haunch area in a sparse grouping.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper posterior haunch are aligned horizontally relative to the dorsal plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiral lyrate curvature; vectors extend outward and posterior from the base before curving medially and superiorly.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between terminal tips is approximately 2.6 times the transverse width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately the distal 15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright orange-tan coloration on all four lower limbs below the knee/hock; long, shaggy dark hair fringe along the ventral midline and neck; white facial markings including sub-ocular spots and a partial chevron.
